description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the EmployeeAttendance API in the OrangeHRM system. It tests retrieving and handling employee attendance data, specifically testing the 'getOne' method, and checks that other methods like 'update', 'delete' and their validation rules are not implemented.

classes.name: EmployeeAttendanceAPITest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeLatestAttendanceRecordAPI, testing retrieval and validation functionalities.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of a single employee attendance record using mock services and fixture data.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Confirms that the update method is not implemented and throws the expected exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Confirms that the validation rule method for update is not implemented.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Confirms that the delete method is not implemented.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Confirms that the validation rule for delete is not implemented.
